finish_summary: Built a complete 3D zombie shooter in a single HTML file (zombie_game.html, ~212 lines) using Three.js. Features: FPS controls (WASD movement, Shift sprint, mouse-look via pointer lock), zombies that spawn in waves and chase the player with glowing red eyes, raycast shooting (click to fire, 3 hits to kill), health/score HUD, fog and moonlit lighting, ground grid with obstacle crates, death screen with restart. Open the file in a browser and click to lock the mouse and play.
